sentences.en: It is in early spring that daffodils come into bloom.
That one spring carries the whole weight of the car.
sentences.zh: 这个弹簧承载着整辆车的重量。

sentences.en: Speaking of Switzerland, have you ever been there in spring?
sentences.zh: 说到瑞士，你有在春天去过那里吗？
